description: This file is a PHP source file that manages custom fields assignment and configuration for test projects in the TestLink open source test management tool. It includes functions for initializing arguments, handling user actions, getting test project info, and managing custom field attributes such as active, required, and monitorable states. The script also renders a GUI template with the current state of custom fields linked to a test project, allowing users to assign, unassign, reorder, and modify boolean attributes.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard generic class used to create objects dynamically to hold properties such as args and gui data.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering the GUI template.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class used to retrieve hierarchy information about test projects.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Creates an object containing user inputs by processing the $_REQUEST array.

methods.name: getTproj
methods.description: Retrieves test project information based on the provided ID, setting project name and ID.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the graphical user interface data structure based on current user selections and test project info.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to manage custom fields.

methods.name: createLocationsMenu
methods.description: Creates a menu structure for location selection, based on provided location data.

methods.name: doRequiredMgmt
methods.description: Manages the 'required' attribute of custom fields for a test project.

methods.name: doActiveMgmt
methods.description: Handles enabling or disabling custom fields as active for a test project.

methods.name: doMonitorableMgmt
methods.description: Handles setting custom fields as monitorable or not for a test project.

methods.name: doSimpleBooleanMgmt
methods.description: Generic function to process boolean attributes (active, required, monitorable) based on submitted form data.
